description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing tags within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, viewing, editing, creating, updating, and deleting tags and tag groups, with associated URL routing and permission checks.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Tag
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing tags and tag groups in the Coocook application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of all tag groups and tags, preparing data for JSON and HTML views.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag by ID and stores it in the stash for further processing.

methods.name: tag_group
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag group by ID and stores it in the stash.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag, including related articles, dishes, and recipes.

methods.name: delete_group
methods.description: Deletes a specified tag group if it is deletable.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag, optionally associating it with a tag group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag with new data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Handles redirection after create, update, or delete actions.
